chip.description: Eight-voice stereo wavetable generator of Namco System 1; unlike the 15XX it uses no waveform PROM and delivers its own samples to one or two 99XX DACs.
chip.notes: src/devices/sound/namco.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("8-voice stereo (System 1) ... The later CUS30 also uses the 99XX DAC, or two 99XX in the optional 16-channel stereo configuration, but it uses no PROM and delivers its own samples. The CUS30 has been decapped and verified to be a ULA").
